title: rangetest counter comment overclaims coverage: now_provider uncounted
description: 3x review P3 (jkli, bead jkli): lichen/tests/coap_rangetest/src/main.c:103 comment claims counters prove the 4.01 gate fires before 'any provider work', but only get_metrics/get_hops are counted; now_provider (time_now() in build_senml, coap_rangetest.c:669) is also a provider callback and is not counted, so a hypothetical regression calling time_now() standalone pre-gate would be missed. Fix: reword comment to 'metrics/hops provider work' (or add now_calls counter). Reviewer marked it dismissible; realistic regressions move the whole build_senml call and are caught.
close_reason: Fixed: comment now scopes the guarantee to metrics/hops provider work and documents that now_provider is only reachable via the same build_senml call the metrics counter covers. Suite re-run 13/13 PASS.
